body.x: Gosh! presents Parallel at CES 2013, amongst other innovations.

Pure functionality for technological products no longer works for the savvy consumers of today. Products cannot just serve the basic purpose it was built for. Consumers want form. They want function. They need beauty. And most of all, they want the compatibility to their personality, their lifestyle and sometimes as a reflection of their mood.

Like the iPhone 5, Parallel is set to woo the consumers with a super battery bank of 2,500mAh – that’s a whooping 1.7X more lifespan. You will never have to worry about the phone not lasting a full day of heavy usage. This is extremely convenient for consumers who are always on the go and making full use of data tethering and other battery-intensive functions on the iPhone 5. While this is the upside, there is actually no downside because Parallel comes with a sleek and slim profile designed ergonomically to fit well in your hands. Comes with a built-in lightning cable and 5 colors matching protective case, Parallel is ‘good-looking’ and yet robustly functional. It is also easily detachable when you do not need the extra juice.

And all of the above comes without a bulky personality – which is seemingly impossible. In fact, it maintains the same length as the iPhone 5 after you put Parallel on. Therefore if you weigh the utility you get out of the extra performance versus the minimal increase in thickness and zero increase in length, you will be pleasantly delighted.
